<a id="llm-security"></a>
## LLM Application Security

| Resource | Type | Level | Cost | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ⭐ [OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications](https://genai.owasp.org/llm-top-10/) | framework | B·I | 🆓 free | OWASP's list of the most critical risks for applications built on large language models. |
| [Damn Vulnerable LLM Agent](https://github.com/WithSecureLabs/damn-vulnerable-llm-agent) | lab | I | 🆓 free | Intentionally vulnerable LLM agent for learning about prompt injection in ReAct-style agents. |
| [Embrace The Red](https://embracethered.com/blog/) | blog | I·A | 🆓 free | Johann Rehberger's research on prompt injection and data exfiltration in AI assistants. |
| [Gandalf (Lakera)](https://gandalf.lakera.ai/) | lab | B | 🆓 free | Popular game that teaches prompt injection by tricking an LLM into revealing a password. |
| [Google Secure AI Framework (SAIF)](https://saif.google/) | framework | B·I | 🆓 free | Google's conceptual framework and resources for securing AI systems. |
| [Indirect Prompt Injection (Greshake et al.)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2302.12173) | paper | I·A | 🆓 free | Influential paper showing how LLM-integrated applications can be compromised via injected content. |
| [LLM Guard](https://github.com/protectai/llm-guard) | tool | I | 🆓 free | Security toolkit for sanitising LLM inputs and outputs. |
| [mcp-scan](https://github.com/invariantlabs-ai/mcp-scan) | tool | I | 🆓 free | Scans Model Context Protocol servers for tool poisoning and other security issues. |
| [NeMo Guardrails](https://github.com/NVIDIA/NeMo-Guardrails) | tool | I | 🆓 free | NVIDIA toolkit for adding programmable guardrails to LLM-based conversational systems. |
| [NIST AI Risk Management Framework](https://www.nist.gov/itl/ai-risk-management-framework) | framework | B·I | 🆓 free | NIST's voluntary framework for managing risks of AI systems across their lifecycle. |
| [OWASP AI Exchange](https://owaspai.org/) | framework | I·A | 🆓 free | Open, comprehensive guidance on protecting AI systems against threats, contributed to global standards. |
| [PortSwigger: Web LLM attacks](https://portswigger.net/web-security/llm-attacks) | course | B·I | 🆓 free | Free Web Security Academy topic with labs on attacking LLM-integrated web applications. |
| [Simon Willison on prompt injection](https://simonwillison.net/tags/prompt-injection/) | blog | B·I | 🆓 free | Long-running series of clear, practical writing about prompt injection and LLM security. |

## Adversarial ML

| Resource | Type | Level | Cost | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ⭐ [MITRE ATLAS](https://atlas.mitre.org/) | framework | I·A | 🆓 free | Knowledge base of adversary tactics and techniques against AI-enabled systems, modelled after ATT&CK. |
| [Adversarial Robustness Toolbox](https://github.com/Trusted-AI/adversarial-robustness-toolbox) | tool | I·A | 🆓 free | Python library for evaluating and defending ML models against evasion, poisoning, extraction and inference attacks. |
| [Explaining and Harnessing Adversarial Examples](https://arxiv.org/abs/1412.6572) | paper | A | 🆓 free | Goodfellow et al.'s seminal paper introducing the fast gradient sign method. |
| [TextAttack](https://github.com/QData/TextAttack) | tool | I·A | 🆓 free | Framework for adversarial attacks, data augmentation and adversarial training in NLP. |
| [Universal and Transferable Adversarial Attacks on Aligned LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.15043) | paper | A | 🆓 free | Research demonstrating automatically generated adversarial suffixes that transfer across models. |
